🔄 Content Updated (Published: November 26, 2026 / Previous: November 24, 2026)
Main changes: Opening time moved from 9:45 a.m. to 9:30 a.m.; participation fee of 300 yen (materials and insurance) added.

On Sunday, December 6, 2026 (Reiwa 8), from 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m., Hanno City Museum (Learning & Research Room) will hold a Children's Cultural Heritage Class: Make Japanese Hand-Bound Books.

Open to elementary school children and younger, accompanied by their guardians. Participants will view and handle Edo-period historical documents, learn about the history of writing and books, and make a hand-bound book.

Since the craft uses pointed tools such as pointed awls and needles, a guardian's accompaniment is required.

Capacity: 10 groups (first-come, first-served). Participation fee: 300 yen per child making a book (materials and insurance). Accompanying guardians are free.

Applications accepted from 10:00 a.m. on Tuesday, November 17 until 4:00 p.m. on Tuesday, December 1. Apply at the museum (online preferred), or by window, phone, or email. On the museum's closed days, call 042-972-2301 (Cultural Heritage Division).

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kyoikubu/hakubutsukan/bunkazaitanto/bunkazai/14388.html
